title: Snippet palette inserts nothing on tap or on its + button; only drag works, while the panel says 'or tap to insert'
what_happened: The Snippets panel advertises '19 snippets available' and its footer reads 'Drag templates to the sequence tree or tap to insert'. With the root 'Sequence' InstructionSet selected (Properties confirmed: InstructionSet, 3 children) I tapped 'Autofocus Routine' and 'HFR-Triggered AF', and separately clicked each card's explicit '+' button. Node count stayed at 26 and the root stayed at '3 steps' every time. No snackbar, no dialog, and the app log stayed silent. Dragging the same card into the tree with a real press-move-release DID insert it (26 -> 27 nodes, root 3 -> 4 steps).
expected: Tapping a snippet card, or clicking its + button, inserts the snippet - or, if insertion is impossible, says why.
repro: Sequencer > Builder > Snippets tab. Click the root 'Sequence' row in the tree so a container is selected. Tap the 'Autofocus Routine' card body; check the node count in the header. Then click that card's '+'; check again. Then press and drag the card onto the tree and release: only this last one works.
evidence: /tmp/ns-audit/shots/sequencer-build-71-sniptap.png (root container selected, card tapped, header still '26 nodes', root still '3 steps'), /tmp/ns-audit/shots/sequencer-build-69-snipplus.png (after clicking '+', unchanged), post-drag tree read: '27 nodes' / '4 steps'
where: packages/skotiq_app/lib/screens/sequencer/sequencer_screen_parts/snippet_palette.dart:10-33 (onSnippetTap -> withSequenceMutation -> insertSnippet); card affordances in widgets/snippet_palette/actions.dart
proposed_fix: Trace why the tap path never reaches insertSnippet (the drag path shares the same TemplateSnippet payload and works, so the snippet data is fine). Wire the card's + button to the same handler as the drag target, and if withSequenceMutation swallows an exception, surface it - a silent catch on a user-initiated action is what makes this invisible.
verdict_reasoning: Reproduced with the root 'Sequence' InstructionSet selected (Properties: InstructionSet, 2 children). Single tap on the 'Autofocus Routine' card body: node count unchanged (2 nodes / 1 step). Click on the card's '+' affordance: unchanged. Footer text confirmed verbatim: 'Drag templates to the sequence tree or tap to insert' (rendering.dart:276; screenshot sbv-10-snippets.png). REFUTED sub-claim: 'only drag works'. A double-click on the same card DID insert (xdotool click --repeat 2 at the same point: 2 nodes/1 step -> 3 nodes/2 steps). Root cause found and it is not a swallowed exception: draggable_item.dart:187-188 binds only onDoubleTap on the desktop path (_buildDesktopItem), and the LucideIcons.plus at :278 is a bare Icon rendered on hover, not a button; the single-tap InkWell exists only on the mobile path (:52-53). So the 'trace why the tap path never reaches insertSnippet' fix note is misdirected, and the 'card affordances in widgets/snippet_palette/actions.dart' pointer is wrong (actions.dart is the overflow menu). Severity corrected P1->P3: two working insert paths exist (double-click, drag) and the Nodes palette footer already says 'double-click to add'; this is a copy/affordance mismatch.

title: Palette search never ranks the exact node-name match first, so typing a node's name adds a different node
what_happened: The palette matches on name OR description and returns results in catalogue order, so a description hit outranks an exact name hit. Three separate searches during this sweep added the wrong node: typing 'Dither' listed 'Smart Exposure' first (its description reads 'handles rotation + dither') and I added a Smart Exposure instead of a Dither; typing 'start guiding' listed 'Photometry Run (template)' first (description 'Center, start guiding, then run AAVSO-grade photometry') and added a 3-child container; typing 'loop' listed 'Instruction Set' first (description 'Group instructions sequentially (no loop)') and added an InstructionSet.
expected: An exact or prefix match on the node NAME ranks above any description match. Typing 'Dither' and clicking the first result must add a Dither node.
repro: Sequencer > Builder > Nodes tab. Type 'Dither' in 'Search nodes...' - Smart Exposure is listed first. Type 'start guiding' - Photometry Run (template) is first. Type 'loop' - Instruction Set is first.
proposed_fix: Score matches: exact name == 100, name startsWith == 80, name contains == 60, description contains == 20; sort descending and keep category grouping only as a visual header. Optionally bold the matched substring so the user can see why a row matched.
verdict_reasoning: All three stated searches reproduce live. 'Dither' -> Imaging category lists 'Smart Exposure' (description 'One row per filter; handles rotation + dither') above 'Dither'. 'loop' -> Logic category lists 'Instruction Set' (description 'Group instructions sequentially (no loop)') above 'Loop'. 'start guiding' -> Science category's 'Photometry Run (template)' (description 'Center, start guiding, then run AAVSO-grade photometry') above Guiding category's 'Start Guiding'. Code matches: sequencer_screen_parts/node_palette.dart:35-50 filters on name.contains(q) || description.contains(q) and preserves catalogue/category order with no scoring; category order in providers/sequence/node_palette.dart is Target, Imaging, Science, Guiding, ... , Logic. Severity corrected P1->P3: every row displays its own name under a visible category header, so this misranks results rather than performing a wrong action; the wrong-node adds in the original sweep were the agent clicking the first row without reading it.

title: Quick-Start Wizard's target search silently returns nothing on a fresh install
what_happened: Step 1 says 'Search for a target or enter coordinates manually' with a magnifier-prefixed 'Target Name' field hinting 'e.g., M42, NGC 7000, Orion Nebula'. Typing 'M31' shows a brief spinner and then nothing: no results list, no message, RA/Dec stay empty. Pressing Enter does nothing. The cause is that the scratch profile's `targets` table has 0 rows (catalogs not downloaded yet) and the widget has no empty-results branch.
expected: 'No catalog installed - download catalogs in Settings' (or 'No match for "M31"'), so the user knows whether the feature is broken or the data is missing.
repro: Fresh profile. Sequencer > Templates > Quick-Start Wizard > type 'M31' in Target Name > wait > press Enter. Then: sqlite3 <profile>/data/skotiq.db 'select count(*) from targets;' -> 0
proposed_fix: Add an else branch. Distinguish 'catalog empty' (targets table has 0 rows -> link to catalog download) from 'no match' (non-empty catalog, 0 hits).
verdict_reasoning: Reproduced on the fresh scratch profile. Step 1 reads 'Search for a target or enter coordinates manually' with a magnifier-prefixed Target Name field; typing 'M31' produced no results list, no message, and RA/Dec stayed empty (sbv-46-qssearch.png). sqlite3 .../skotiq.db 'select count(*) from targets;' -> 0. Code confirms the missing branch: _target_step.dart:68 is `if (_searchResults.isNotEmpty)` with no else anywhere in the widget. One detail differs cosmetically: the field showed the label 'Target Name' rather than the quoted hint 'e.g., M42, NGC 7000, Orion Nebula' (the hint presumably shows only when the label is not floated). Severity corrected P2->P3: a missing empty-state message on a first-run-only data gap; the manual RA/Dec path on the same step works and the wizard completes.

title: Preflight lists the same missing guider twice as two separate warnings
what_happened: Pre-Flight Validation on a sequence with a Dither node shows both 'No Guider Connected - This sequence includes guiding or dithering operations that require PHD2' and 'Guider Not Connected - Dither requires a guider (PHD2) but none is connected', each with the identical hint 'Connect to PHD2 in the Guiding panel.' Both count toward the '5 warnings' badge, so the summary overstates how many distinct problems exist.
repro: Sequencer > Builder > add a Dither node with no guider connected > Start > scroll the Pre-Flight list.
proposed_fix: De-duplicate by (category, equipment kind) before the dialog renders, keeping the more specific message.
verdict_reasoning: Reproduced. With a Dither node and no guider connected, Pre-Flight Validation shows two consecutive Equipment warnings: 'No Guider Connected - This sequence includes guiding or dithering operations that require PHD2.' and 'Guider Not Connected - Dither requires a guider (PHD2) but none is connected.', both carrying the identical hint 'Connect to PHD2 in the Guiding panel.' (sbv-41-pf3.png). Both count toward the badge: the dialog header read '1 error, 3 warnings' where the three warnings are No Exposures + these two. Severity P3 upheld.

title: Header node count includes the invisible root container, so an empty sequence reads '1 node' next to '0 steps'
what_happened: A brand-new sequence shows '0 targets | 1 node' in the header while the tree body immediately below shows 'Sequence / 0 steps'. Every subsequent count is off by one the same way (9 steps / 10 nodes, 11 steps / 12 nodes).
expected: The header count should match what the user can see and select - the instruction count, not the instruction count plus the implicit root.
repro: Sequencer > Builder > toolbar 'New Sequence'. Read the header chip and the root row on the same screen.
proposed_fix: Count sequence.nodes.length - 1 (or exclude the rootNodeId explicitly).
verdict_reasoning: Reproduced immediately on arrival at the Sequencer: header chip '0 targets | 1 node' with the tree body directly below showing 'Sequence / 0 steps' (sbv-05-seq.png), and the off-by-one held at every size I built (2 nodes/1 step, 5 nodes/4 steps, 9 nodes/5 steps once nesting was added, 17 nodes for the wizard sequence). Code confirms the named location: sequence_tree/sequence_header.dart:216-218 renders '${sequence.nodes.length} ${sequence.nodes.length == 1 ? 'node' : 'nodes'}' with no root exclusion. Note the count is already correctly pluralised there, contrary to the sibling finding about 'Save as Template'. Severity P3 upheld.

title: Toolbar's 13 icon buttons expose no accessible names at all
what_happened: The AT-SPI tree for the Sequencer screen contains exactly one named toolbar control: 'button: Start'. The other thirteen actions (New Sequence, Quick-Start Wizard, Calibrate Flat Exposures, Plan Mosaic, Plan Tonight, Open Sequence, Import from NINA/SGP, Save Sequence, Polar Alignment, Exposure Triggers, Slew to Target, Undo, Redo) appear nowhere in the tree and carry no visible text label, only a Lucide glyph. They are unreachable by a screen reader and undiscoverable without hovering each one.
expected: Each icon button exposes its tooltip text as its semantics label, as the tab bar buttons already do ('button: Builder (Alt+1)').
repro:
Sequencer > Builder, then dump the accessibility tree (tools/ui_audit/drive_linux.py tree --profile

): only 'button: Start' appears from the toolbar row.
evidence: tree output in this session vs /tmp/ns-audit/shots/sequencer-build-03-seq.png (13 unlabeled glyphs between Start and the frame counter)
proposed_fix: Wrap each _ToolbarIconButton in Semantics(button: true, label: action.label) - the label strings already exist and are used for tooltips.
verdict_reasoning: Reproduced via the AT-SPI dump. A full tree of the Sequencer screen (87 lines, /tmp/ns-audit/tree-sbv.txt) contains only these named buttons: 'Builder (Alt+1)', 'Templates (Alt+2)', 'Sequences (Alt+3)', 'History (Alt+4)' and the tree's own 'button: Sequence'. None of New Sequence / Quick-Start Wizard / Calibrate Flat Exposures / Plan Mosaic / Plan Tonight / Open Sequence / Import from NINA-SGP / Save Sequence / Polar Alignment / Exposure Triggers / Slew to Target / Undo / Redo appears as a control (the 'Slew to Target' and 'New Sequence' hits in the dump are a palette item and the sequence's own name). Code confirms the cause at the named location: sequence_toolbar/icon_and_status.dart:27-35 wraps a bare GestureDetector+Icon in Tooltip(message:) with no Semantics(button: true, label:), while the label strings already exist (sequence_toolbar.dart:439-521). Minor correction: 'Start' appears in the tree as a panel, not 'button: Start'. Severity P3 upheld.

title: 'Save as Template' accepts an empty sequence and says 'This will save 1 nodes'
what_happened: With a freshly created (empty) sequence, Templates > Save as Template opens with the info line 'This will save 1 nodes from the current sequence.' - ungrammatical, and the '1' is the invisible root container. Nothing prevents saving a template with no instructions in it.
expected: Pluralise, count real instructions, and disable Save Template when there are none (with a reason).
repro: Sequencer > Builder > toolbar 'New Sequence' > Templates tab > 'Save as Template'.
proposed_fix: Reuse the same corrected node count as the header fix, pluralise, and gate the primary action.
verdict_reasoning: Reproduced. On a freshly created empty sequence, Templates > Save as Template opens with the info line 'This will save 1 nodes from the current sequence.' and an enabled 'Save Template' button (sbv-55-savetpl.png). Code confirms: the dialog interpolates widget.sequence.nodes.length with a hardcoded 'nodes' at lines 283-285, and the primary action is gated only on _isSaving (line 317), never on node count. Correction to the 'where' field: the file is packages/skotiq_app/lib/screens/sequencer/tabs/templates_tab_parts/_save_template_dialog.dart, not tabs/template_tab/. Note this shares its root cause (counting sequence.nodes.length including the implicit root) with the 'Header node count includes the invisible root container' finding and should be fixed together; it is not a pure duplicate because the missing empty-sequence gate is independent. Severity P3 upheld.
